title: 10 月手游下载榜：Roblox、Free Fire、Block Blast、Meowdoku、Brain Puzzle 等
content:
October’s mobile game download chart: Roblox, Free Fire, Block Blast, Meowdoku, Brain Puzzle, more – Mobilegamer.biz
Skip to content
Here are the top mobile game downloads from last month, according to
Appmagic
data.
Appmagic’s estimates do not include numbers from China’s fractured Android market. There’s also commentary on October’s most notable trends from the top 20 and beyond below.
In between these monthly updates, you can also keep tabs on
Appmagic’s top grossing and top downloads charts here
.
And you can find our look at
October’s top grossing charts here
.

AppMagic

Roblox
took the top download spot from Free Fire Max in October, and installs were practically the same as the October 2025 total at 22.5m – not far off the 2026 peak of 22.8m from back in July. This perhaps suggests the UGC platform isn’t just about spiking during school holidays as its players mature(…?) – we’ll see in November’s figures.
Free Fire Max
was leapfrogged due to a general malaise in downloads that has seen Garena’s battle royale gently decline overall since January, by installs at least.
Hungry Studio’s
Block Blast
is gathering momentum again after a sharp decline in monthly downloads that began in January and bottomed out in June. Monthly downloads have been up a little every month since – though installs aren’t anywhere near the peaks it saw in late 2024 and in April and December of 2025.
Despite lingering legal troubles, whatever
Learnings / Oakever Games
is doing with
Meowdoku
is working – it’s been a fixture in the top downloads chart for a while now, and hit an all-time high last month with 17.3m downloads. Whoever came up with that Queens game on LinkedIn, the game on which Meowdoku is based, may well be looking on in envy now…
Here’s a new name in the top installs chart: China-based SmallStep Tech. AppMagic’s numbers seem to have been revised from last month, suggesting
Brain Puzzle 3
is apparently up one spot on last month, though
when we last looked it was in 19th
. Either way, this quirky mix of hidden object and other logic puzzles is pulling in players from a surprisingly even spread of markets, led by the US, Brazil, Indonesia, Mexico and Russia.
Bus Fever Party
is more familiar, and makes the top ten for the second month running after racing up the charts since launch in July.
Players in India are into
Paper.io 2
– they make up 44% of the game’s total downloads in the last 30 days. This one’s enjoying a revival after breaking out big time in 2018(!), tailing off for several years and then slowly gathering download momentum again from early 2022 to now. October 2026 was its best monthly download total since March 2019, in fact.
Singapore-based Nebula Studio has taken a popular UA playable ad format and made it a ‘real’ game with
Rotate Rings
, which rocketed up 190 places to hit eighth spot with 12.6m installs last month. It only launched mid-September, hence the giant leap.
Some usual suspects round out the top ten –
Ludo King
slips down one spot despite growing downloads month-on-month, while
Subway Surfers
drops five places due to a second month of download decline.

The notable month-on-month risers outside the top ten include
Gossip Harbor
(up eight spots),
Magic Tiles 3
(up 12) and
Township
, which rose seven places to 26th spot (~7.3m installs last month).
After some very rapid growth, it seems Ivy Mobile’s Block Blast-inspired
Color Block
(15th) is easing off and is down by about 800k downloads month-on-month. Grand Games’
Block Out
(16th) posted a second month of download decline, while Easybrain’s
Arrow Puzzle
(17th) saw its installs drop for the third month running.
Finally: Android-only game
MemeMix Challenge
is worth noting: it’s a new entry in 21st place with 7.8m installs in its first month on the market.
